patents.patent_title: Split-path excitation network for a piezoresistive bridge sensor
patents.patent_abstract: A pressure sensor includes a piezoresistive bridge driven by a split-path excitation network having a constant-current leg and a proportional-to-absolute-temperature leg whose ratio is set by a single ratio resistor, flattening the span versus temperature curve.

patents.patent_title: Dummy half-bridge offset cancellation for MEMS pressure dies
patents.patent_abstract: A matched dummy half-bridge fabricated adjacent to a sense bridge on the same die supplies a compensation tap that is summed into the bridge output through a fixed divider, cancelling common-mode offset drift without a per-unit trim.

patents.patent_title: Digital calibration of a transducer using a stored lookup table
patents.patent_abstract: A microcontroller reads a temperature sensor and applies a stored lookup table to correct transducer output over a soak-characterized range.
